description: This file contains event handler methods related to user login, password management, and security processes within the OFBiz framework. It includes methods for saving login parameters, handling forgotten passwords, sending password reset emails, and login checks.

classes.name: LoginEvents
classes.description: Contains event handler methods for user login actions, password recovery, and security-related events.

methods.name: saveEntryParams
methods.description: Stores username and password from request parameters into session attributes after applying case normalization based on security properties.

methods.name: forgotPassword
methods.description: Handles user requests for password hints or email-based password resets, delegating to other methods.

methods.name: showPasswordHint
methods.description: Retrieves and displays the password hint for a given username if available.

methods.name: emailPasswordRequest
methods.description: Initiates the process for sending a password reset email, generating a JWT token, constructing email content, and invoking email service.

methods.name: storeCheckLogin
methods.description: Performs login check and validates store-specific customer roles.

methods.name: storeLogin
methods.description: Performs login operation and validates store-specific customer roles, supporting encoding exceptions.
